The EU is switching to mandatory electronic invoicing — Belgium for all businesses (2026), with Germany, France (2027), Poland and more rolling out next. That means a normal PDF is no longer enough. FREE, AND GENUINELY GENEROUS

- Unlimited clients, your logo, and multi-currency with European Central Bank reference rates.
- A real EN 16931 VAT engine: standard rates, intra-community reverse charge, zero-rated and exempt lines — with a correct, properly rounded VAT breakdown on every document.
- Works fully offline. Bill from a job site, a train, anywhere.
- No account required to start. Open the app and you're invoicing.

PRO — REAL E-INVOICE COMPLIANCE, NOT JUST A PDF
- Factur-X / ZUGFeRD e-invoices: a single hybrid file that looks like a clean invoice to your client and carries embedded EN 16931 data a tax authority's system can read automatically. Independently validated as a valid PDF/A-3 with valid EN 16931 XML.
- Peppol delivery: send your invoice straight into your client's accounting system over the EU's official network — no email attachment, no portal logins.
- Recurring invoices: set it once, get paid every month.
- Your branding: logo, accent colour, and templates that look like your business, not a template.
- Live VAT validation: check every client's VAT ID against the EU VIES service before you issue.

CREDIT PACKS — PAY ONLY FOR WHAT YOU SEND
- Top up with consumable credit packs that cover each Peppol network send (we pass through the real per-send cost rather than padding a subscription).
- The same credits power optional AI helpers: snap a photo of a quote or receipt and turn it into line items, type a rough description and let it draft the lines, or generate a tactful payment-reminder email for an overdue invoice. AI actions cost a few credits each and are entirely optional — the app is complete without them.

WHO IT'S FOR
Freelancers, consultants, designers, developers, and small businesses across the EU who invoice other businesses and need to be ready for e-invoicing mandates — without paying for a heavyweight accounting platform.

HONEST PROMISE
The free app is a complete invoicing tool, not a trial. We only ask you to pay where it genuinely costs us or genuinely earns you compliance: structured e-invoices, network delivery, automation, and AI. No fake urgency, no nagging, no surprise limits.

Pay Day Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or annual with a 7-day free trial. Peppol network sends are metered separately via consumable credit packs on every Pro plan. apps.name: Helia: UV Index & Sun Safety
apps.description:
Helia is the honest solar coach. Most sun apps either push you to maximize a tan or just show a raw UV number. Helia does neither. It treats sunlight like what it is — something to enjoy on a budget. The sunburn is the enemy, not the sun.

Helia reads today's UV conditions for your exact location and your skin, then gives you one clear answer: roughly how long you can be in the sun before you should cover up, reapply, or head for shade. That answer — your sunburn budget — is free, forever. We never put safety behind a paywall.

THE FREE SAFETY CORE — for everyone
• Hands-free tracking. Helia can notice when you head out into daylight, meter the session itself, and log it — no timers to start or stop.
• Your sunburn budget. A personalized estimate of how long today's sun may take before your skin has had enough, based on the live UV index and your skin type.
• The Answer. One glance tells you whether it's a cover-up day, a quick-session day, or a stay-out day — no decoding color charts.
• Live UV index + forecast. See the UV climb and fall through the day so you can plan around the harshest hours.
• Cloud- and rain-aware. Helia corrects the UV for the real sky, so an overcast day reads honestly — not as full sun.
• Reapply & cover-up nudges. Gentle reminders to top up sunscreen or step into shade before you've used up your budget.
• Honest by design. Helia rounds toward caution. When in doubt, it tells you to protect.

PRO — the coaching layer (optional)
Pro turns Helia from an instrument into a coach, with guidance grounded in how sunlight affects the body across the day:
• Morning-light timing. Helia suggests when a little outdoor light may help support your daily rhythm and energy — the circadian side of sunlight.
• Your vitamin-D plan. A 12-month, season-aware calendar of what sunlight can realistically contribute at your latitude — including the honest winter months when it can't. The live estimate on Home stays free.
• The Sun Atlas. Every session and every walked Sun Trail on one map — your sun, over time.
• On-device science coach. Ask anything about sun, UV, vitamin D, and your body clock — answered privately on your phone, grounded in cited sources, never the cloud.
• History & trends. Your sun, your budget used, and your patterns over weeks and seasons.

WHY PEOPLE KEEP HELIA INSTALLED
Helia isn't trying to get you a deeper tan or sell you fear. It's a quiet, trustworthy instrument that earns its home-screen spot.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Helia works for you, not on you. Your sun sessions, skin type, and location stay on your device wherever possible and are used to personalize your estimates — not to profile you. Precise location is used only to read your local sun and UV conditions. The coach runs entirely on your device.

A NOTE ON HEALTH
Helia provides general wellness estimates and guidance, not medical advice. Sunburn-budget and vitamin-D figures are estimates based on public UV data and the details you provide — they may differ from reality. Helia does not diagnose, treat, or prevent any condition. For anything concerning your skin or health, please consult a qualified clinician.

Get the free sunburn budget today. Upgrade to Pro when you want the coaching.

Helia Pro is available as an annual or monthly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase.

A free trial converts to a paid annual subscription unless cancelled at least 24 hours before it ends; no payment is due during the trial. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings. apps.name: Tailscode
apps.description:
Tailscode turns your iPhone into the remote control for the coding agents already running on your machines. Send a prompt from anywhere, pocket your phone, and watch the turn finish on your Lock Screen.

It connects point-to-point over your own Tailscale network. No relay servers, no account, no analytics, no middleman reading your code.

WORKS WITH YOUR AGENTS
• opencode — connect straight to opencode serve and drive any provider you have configured.
• Claude Code — via claude-bridge, the open-source companion server that turns Claude Code into structured streaming sessions backed by your subscription.

A LIVE, NATIVE TRANSCRIPT
• Real-time streaming with collapsible thinking and tool-activity groups.
• Syntax-highlighted code blocks with one-tap, byte-exact copy.
• Inline permission approvals — Allow once, Always, or Deny without leaving the chat.
• Agent questions rendered as tappable option cards.
• Steer mid-turn: queue a follow-up while the agent works, edit it before it lands, or stop the turn server-side.
• Slash-command palette, per-message model and reasoning-effort overrides, conversation forking, session cost meters.

YOUR LOCK SCREEN IS THE STATUS BOARD
• A Live Activity per session: phase, elapsed time, and tool counts in real time — thinking, running a tool, writing, or awaiting your approval.
• Approval requests alert you; finished turns linger with the outcome.
• Tap to deep-link into the exact chat. Updates arrive by push even while the app is suspended.

BUILT FOR MULTIPLE MACHINES
• One session list across all your servers, grouped by machine, with live status.
• Tailnet discovery: paste a Tailscale API token and Tailscode finds the agent servers on your devices.
• Server-side file browser to start a chat in any project directory.
• Health checks, auto-reconnect, offline banners.
• Live usage gauges: Claude plan limits, Grok quotas, opencode cost estimates.

NATIVE TO THE CORE
• Programmatic UIKit, Swift 6, zero web views. Liquid Glass on iOS 26.
• Dark mode, Dynamic Type, haptics.
• Open source under GPL-3.0 — the app, the engine, and the bridge.

FREE, WITH AN HONEST PRO
The free app is the complete core: one server, full chat, permissions, attachments, models, forking, and Live Activities. Tailscode Pro — a one-time purchase, no subscription — adds multiple saved servers, concurrent Live Activities, and a supporter badge.

TRY IT BEFORE YOU WIRE ANYTHING
A built-in demo lets you explore every screen with sample sessions — no server needed.

REQUIREMENTS
A computer on your Tailscale network (free for personal use) running opencode or Claude Code via claude-bridge. Tailscode is independent open-source software: not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic, Tailscale Inc., or the opencode project.

Privacy policy: https://midgarcorp.cc/tailscode/privacy
Source code: https://github.com/guitaripod/Tailscode

apps.name: Crucible: Plex Client
apps.description:
Crucible is a fast, native Plex client for iPhone — and a love letter to building iOS apps without a Mac. The whole app is Swift 6 and programmatic UIKit, cross-compiled on Arch Linux and deployed straight to an iPhone over USB. No Xcode, no storyboards, no macOS anywhere in the loop.

EVERYTHING IN ITS PLACE
Continue Watching, On Deck, and Recently Added greet you on the home screen. Browse libraries as poster grids with genre filters and sort options, or dig into raw folders for unindexed content.

A PLAYER THAT RESPECTS YOUR TIME
Skip Intro and Skip Credits straight from Plex markers, Picture-in-Picture with background audio, lock screen and Control Center controls, and Up Next that rolls the next episode as the credits start. Direct play when your device can handle the file, automatic HLS transcoding when it can't.

TAKE IT OFFLINE
Download movies, whole seasons, or single episodes at the quality you pick — Original, High, Medium, Low, or Data Saver. Background transfers keep going when the app is closed and resume after interruptions, downloads stay Wi-Fi-only unless you allow cellular, and a dedicated Downloads tab shows progress, storage used, and free space. A Live Activity tracks live progress on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island — a WidgetKit extension compiled and signed on Arch Linux via xtool — while downloads run in the background, auto-resume from where they left off, and ping you when they finish. Offline playback runs through the same player — Skip Intro/Credits, resume, Picture-in-Picture, background audio, and lock screen controls all work with no network.

GO DEEPER
Cast and crew, More Like This recommendations, subtitle and audio track selection, and adjustable playback speed. Hand a title off between your devices and find what you've watched in Spotlight.

OPEN SOURCE, BUILT ON LINUX
Crucible is free and open source under the GPL-3.0 license, with zero third-party dependencies — pure Apple frameworks. Read the code, file an issue, or build it yourself.

apps.name: Flaccy
apps.description:
Flaccy is a beautiful player for the music you own. Drop in your FLAC, ALAC, AAC, or MP3 files and get a fast, gorgeous library with gapless playback, synced lyrics, and scrobbling — no streaming subscription, no upload, no account.

YOUR LIBRARY, ORGANIZED
• Import via USB or the Files app — messy folder names and scene releases are identified and cleaned up automatically
• Albums, artists, songs, and playlists with search, sorting, and stunning artwork
• Gapless playback that honors your albums, with queue persistence across launches
• Codec, bit depth, and sample rate shown on every track — see exactly what you're playing

MADE FOR LISTENING
• Synced lyrics with tap-to-seek
• Full playback controls on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• AirPlay, sleep timer, and a Now Playing screen with ambient artwork backdrops

SCROBBLE EVERYTHING
• Sign in with Last.fm and every play is scrobbled — even offline, with automatic retry
• Loved tracks, listening charts, and artist bios matched to your library
• Year in Music: shareable story cards and a poster of your listening year

PHONE-FREE ON APPLE WATCH
• Sync tracks to your watch and play them offline — no iPhone required
• A true standalone player: gapless playback, shuffle, repeat, and AirPods controls from your wrist
• Storage-smart sync that knows what fits on your watch

REDISCOVER YOUR COLLECTION
• Start a station from any song — Flaccy builds a queue from your own library
• Suggested playlists and similar-artist trails
• Share any track as a universal streaming link — friends open it in their app, you keep your FLACs

HONEST ABOUT AUDIO
The built-in Listening Guide explains what actually reaches your ears — Bluetooth codecs, why lossless can't reach AirPods, when FLAC is worth it, and what blind tests really show. No snake oil.

Flaccy plays FLAC, ALAC, AAC, M4A, MP3, WAV, AIFF, and CAF.
